name: Cooper Baker
source:
He came to work at Valarie’s 5 months before Lauren's art block happened. Ever since then he’s been helping in the studio and trying his best to keep everyone having fun.

He is positive and very friendly, however he doesn’t work well with the Ortiz’s guys. Especially Millo who can easily make Cooper lose his temper.

He isn't good with words and doesn't know how to convey his feelings. Dani usually says that he is too slow and always puts others' above him.

Cooper is kind, thoughtful and he loves taking pictures of animals.

He came to work at Valarie’s 5 months before Lauren's art block happened. Ever since then he’s been helping in the studio and trying his best to keep everyone having fun.
